changeLog: Straker Beta 13: a hero you pick in the lobby is kept when the generated map already holds that hero as a prisoner; guests see the random map mode's name; the warning for a player with no town no longer freezes the screen's turn timer while it is open; building pop-ups name what a prize holds (a war machine, a treasure artifact) and state a price once; the crash window looks like the launcher; a computer player's battle moves on after two refused spells (a fallback: the cause is still being looked for). Everyone who plays together must update to beta 13 first.
